name: dsh-context-rollover-compat
description: Type-probe environment: the pinned PUBLIC dsh package line the plugin must typecheck against. Pinned deliberately — `latest` on npm is 0.0.1-rc.1, far behind the `alpha` line, so a floating spec silently probes an ancient build. Bump these together, then run `pnpm run compat:install && pnpm run typecheck:compat`.
